```{r load}
library(tidyverse)
df <- read_csv("../data/bc_full_factorial_dataset.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
cond_stats <- df %>%
  group_by(condition_id) %>%
  summarise(mean_yield = mean(BC_yield_gL),
            pH = first(pH), Temp_C = first(Temp_C), RPM = first(RPM),
            Inoculum_pct = first(Inoculum_pct), Sugar_gL = first(Sugar_gL),
            .groups = "drop")
levels_list <- list(
  pH = c(4.0, 4.5, 5.0, 5.5, 6.0), Temp_C = c(25, 27.5, 30, 32.5, 35),
  RPM = c(50, 87.5, 125, 162.5, 200), Inoculum_pct = c(5, 7.5, 10, 12.5, 15),
  Sugar_gL = c(20, 30, 40, 50, 60))
get_neighbours <- function(cr) {
  nb <- list(); for (f in names(levels_list)) {
    vals <- levels_list[[f]]; idx <- which(vals == cr[[f]])
    for (d in c(-1,1)) { ni <- idx+d; if (ni>=1 && ni<=length(vals)) {
      nr <- cr; nr[[f]] <- vals[ni]; nb <- c(nb, list(nr)) }}}
  bind_rows(nb)
}
sa <- function(start_id, n_iter=500, T0=1.0, alpha=0.95) {
  cur <- cond_stats %>% filter(condition_id==start_id); cy <- cur$mean_yield
  best <- cur; by <- cy; T <- T0; n_acc <- 0
  for (i in 1:n_iter) {
    nbs <- get_neighbours(cur); cand <- nbs %>% slice_sample(n=1)
    cand <- cond_stats %>% filter(pH==cand$pH,Temp_C==cand$Temp_C,RPM==cand$RPM,
      Inoculum_pct==cand$Inoculum_pct,Sugar_gL==cand$Sugar_gL)
    delta <- cand$mean_yield - cy
    if (delta > 0 || runif(1) < exp(delta/T)) {
      cur <- cand; cy <- cur$mean_yield; n_acc <- n_acc+1
      if (cy > by) { best <- cur; by <- cy }
    }
    T <- T * alpha
  }
  list(best=best, best_yield=by, acceptance_rate=n_acc/n_iter)
}
```

## Exercise 1 — Temperature schedule
```{r ex1}
set.seed(42); start <- sample(cond_stats$condition_id, 1)
for (T0 in c(0.1, 1.0, 10.0)) {
  res <- sa(start, T0=T0)
  cat(sprintf("T0=%.1f -> yield=%.3f, accept=%.1f%%\n", T0, res$best_yield, 100*res$acceptance_rate))
}
```

## Exercise 2 — Cooling rate
```{r ex2}
set.seed(42)
for (alpha in c(0.90, 0.95, 0.99)) {
  res <- sa(start, alpha=alpha)
  cat(sprintf("alpha=%.2f -> yield=%.3f, accept=%.1f%%\n", alpha, res$best_yield, 100*res$acceptance_rate))
}
```
